title: Fix SplitThinking, silent exception catch, and validation error clobbering
description:
P1: Three independent small fixes batched together:

1. **SplitThinking only strips first `<think>` block** (80% confidence): `ChatServices.cs:940` uses `Regex.Match` (single match), not `Matches`. Multiple `<think>` segments leak raw tags into visible reply from second occurrence onward. Fix: use `Regex.Matches` to strip and aggregate all occurrences.

2. **Silent exception swallow in `GitHubCopilotChatProvider.ListModelsAsync`** (90% confidence): `ChatServices.cs:1245` — `catch when (chatOptions.GitHubModels.Count > 0)` with zero logging inside catch. Fix: add `_logger.LogWarning` inside the catch block.

3. **Validation errors clobbered under wrong key** (95% confidence): `MemoryApplicationService.ValidateRecord` writes tag-count error to `errors["Tags"]`, then unconditionally overwrites same key with governance-diagnostic errors. Fix: use `errors["Governance"]` for governance errors or merge instead of overwrite.

Evidence: MemorySmith-Audit-Delta-2-20260702.md §3, §4; MemorySmith-Audit-Delta-5-20260702.md §1; council/audit-synthesis-council-20260705.md

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 6-seat council audit synthesis. Source-Grounded Archivist confirmed SplitThinking and silent catch at 90-92% confidence. Validation error clobbering not independently verified (70% confidence). Batched as three small independent fixes.
